title: German-Style Roast Vegetable Panini
description: A flavorful vegetarian panini filled with roasted vegetables and melted cheese, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Toss the sliced roast with vegetable oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Assemble the panini by spreading melted cheese on the toasted bread, then topping with roasted vegetables.
Place the other bread slice on top to complete the panini.
Cut the panini in half and serve immediately.
